title: When the workout copy stops saving, the member is told only inside Settings
what: If the member's MettleUp sign-in runs out or the saved copy is full, the copy stops and the phone keeps the workouts only on itself. The app writes one line on the Settings account card and nowhere else: no pop-up, no banner on the Workout tab, no note after a workout. A member who never opens Settings keeps training for weeks believing everything is saved, and loses it all with the phone.
expected: When the copy stops for a reason the member can fix (sign in again, copy full), the member is told where they already look, for example after saving a workout, with one tap to fix it.
how_often: every time a sign-in runs out or a copy fills up
fix_line: Show a short note after saving a workout while the copy is stopped, with a Sign in again button

title: A restored backup switches workout reminders and gym alerts back on, but on a new phone they may silently never arrive
what: Restoring a backup puts back the reminder switch, its days and time, and the gym reminder and gym message switches, and sets the reminders at once. It does not ask the phone for permission to show notifications, and the done message says nothing about reminders (it only mentions Health Connect). On a new phone where notifications were never allowed, the switch says on and nothing comes until the member happens to start a workout or open Profile. The gym switches also say on while the gym link itself is not in the backup, so no gym reminder or message can come until the member joins the gym again.
expected: After a restore with reminders on, the phone asks for notification permission (or the done message says reminders need it), and gym alerts say they start once the gym is joined again.
who: members moving to a new phone with a backup file
how_often: each restore on a phone that never allowed notifications
fix_line: Ask for notification permission after a restore that turns reminders on, and say so in the done message
